name: computed-null-optional
$comment: ENH-028 null-removal semantics: an optional computed field (`nick` = coalesce(nickname)) stores NO key when the expression evaluates null — the unset-optional shape convention, never a stored null. Ada carries nickname "Ace" at insert (nick stamped "Ace"), then a patch nulls the input: the optional input key is stripped AND the recomputed null REMOVES the computed key. Bo never had the input (key absent straight from insert); Cy keeps hers (coalesce passthrough, nick = "Cee"). Full-equality on the unordered collect makes each absence and the one presence itself the assertion. Mirrors computed_test.rs (7).
